name: Stripe Directory

sources.title: Stripe Docs — Stripe Directory (preview): indexes Stripe Apps, Stripe Projects providers, MPP endpoints, and the Stripe business network

conditions: There is no public submit form — a business appears in the Directory by existing inside the Stripe ecosystem: a published Stripe App on marketplace.stripe.com, a Stripe Projects provider, a machine-payments (mpp.dev) endpoint, or a Stripe business-network profile
Each of those paths requires a real Stripe account and its own approval/build process
requirements: The Directory is a preview feature queried via the Stripe CLI ('stripe directory search') — it returns provider entries for developers and AI agents, not a browsable SEO listing
For a SaaS product the realistic presence is a published Stripe App (requires building an app and passing Stripe review) or a Stripe business profile tied to a live Stripe account
preparation: A verified Stripe account for the business
If pursuing the App route: a working Stripe App built against the apps SDK, ready for marketplace review
If pursuing the MPP route: a documented pay-per-call payment workflow on mpp.dev
workflow: Confirm the business has a live Stripe account and public Stripe profile (stripe.com/@handle)
Choose the strongest surface: publish a Stripe App via the marketplace review, become a Stripe Projects provider, or expose an MPP endpoint
Verify presence by running 'stripe directory search "<brand>" --format json' after the listing/app is approved
watchFor: The batch-listed link type is 'nofollow' but there is no classic public listing page to inspect — the Directory surface is CLI/agent output
Feedback channel is directory@stripe.com per the docs — there is no documented 'request inclusion' form on the page read
Do not treat this as a quick citation: every route in is gated on real Stripe integration work
countsAsLive: The business/app/provider is returned by 'stripe directory search' results with its profile handle or listing data
unknowns: Exact criteria for inclusion in the 'Stripe business network' index — the docs do not describe an enrollment step
Whether any free/fast path exists for a business that uses Stripe only for payments
Link attribute of any public-facing profile page (stripe.com/@handle) — not documented on the fetched page
